description:
Body of `content_vanished`: one batch of retention expiry in one channel. Clients drop every
listed message (with its reactions and pin), keep a placeholder for `tombstone_ids` (roots
with live replies), and drop listed attachments. Not lossy.

attachments.description: Attachments that vanished from live messages.

items.description: A Sew id: a decimal string of a 64-bit time-sortable id (1 to 9223372036854775807).

seq.description: The highest channel seq the batch appended.

tombstone_ids.description: Those of them that stay as a placeholder (roots with live replies).
